tolerance_basis: Authored illustration-QA bands at1.8m character scale. Reuses the accepted first-batch12mm curved-support band,20% near fraction and4mm maximum skin-floor penetration. Not medical landmarks, safe joint limits, clinical technique or physical contact certification.

pelvic_support.rationale: Actual posterior pelvic/upper-thigh junction skin supporting the seated/supine body. Search is bounded to the original posterior pelvic skin and manually reviewed in solid/side views. Not a clinically localized load-bearing landmark.
pelvic_support.selection: Local original skin quads containing the actual lowest floor-facing source skin point in the declared search region at representative phases; frozen original IDs, not a glute atlas or clinical ischial landmark.

foot_edge_L.rationale: Actual lateral/medial foot-edge skin on the shared floor in the seated90/90 pose; not a falsely flat plantar sole.
foot_edge_L.selection: Local original skin quads containing the actual lowest floor-facing source skin point in the declared search region at representative phases; frozen original IDs, not a glute atlas or clinical ischial landmark.

thigh_L.rationale: Local outer seated leg skin; floor clearance distribution is reported. Curved shin need not lie flat along its entire length.
thigh_L.selection: Local original skin quads containing the actual lowest floor-facing source skin point in the declared search region at representative phases; frozen original IDs, not a glute atlas or clinical ischial landmark.
